description: This file defines application configuration settings loaded from environment variables, encapsulated within the Settings class. It also provides a cached factory function to retrieve a singleton instance of these settings.

classes.name: Settings
classes.description: Encapsulates application configuration loaded from environment variables, including secret keys, token expiration, allowed CORS origins, and database URL (by reference).

methods.name: None __init__(self)
methods.description: Initializes Settings instance by reading environment variables and providing default values or raising errors if critical variables are missing.

methods.name: Settings get_settings()
methods.description: Returns a cached singleton instance of the Settings class, ensuring environment is read only once.
